name: second-dawn
title: Second Dawn (beta)
author: aastashov
description: BETA, in testing. A total overhaul where Factorio meets Dr. Stone: humanity turned to stone, and you rebuild civilisation from clay and fire to a rocket to the Moon, before petrification waves come back. The first epochs feel a bit like a farm (clay, wood, gardens, jugs); from bronze and steam on it is a full factory. Base 2.0, no Space Age. Multiplayer supported. Made with AI (Claude, ChatGPT), directed and playtested by a human.
